meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用接入微信个人号,扫码登录后即可收发私聊消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让自己的应用或机器人接上微信个人号收发消息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your app or bot to send and receive messages on a personal WeChat account

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加个人微信频道:它把微信适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目、装好依赖,用腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 长轮询收发微信消息,登录靠手机扫码,不需要 webhook 和付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信渠道,或在 /setup 流程中需要微信支持时触发;它会复制适配器、安装依赖,再引导你扫码登录。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 装上个人微信频道
重启服务后把微信的扫码链接给我
把刚给机器人发消息的微信联系人接到我的 agent group
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts,选目标 agent group

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw: copies the WeChat adapter from the channels branch and installs wechat-ilink-client; messages arrive via Tencent's official iLink Bot API long-polling, and login is a phone QR scan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw, or while running /setup and you need WeChat support. It copies the adapter, installs the dependency, then guides QR login.

say_en.text: Install the personal WeChat channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and installs wechat-ilink-client.

say_en.text: Restart the service and show me the WeChat QR link
say_en.note: Prints the QR URL to the log and data/wechat/qr.txt

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat contact who just messaged to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts; you pick the group and target.
